title: Using Zscaler Client Connector with Cisco AnyConnect on macOS Catalina

blocks.text: If you are using Zscaler Client Connector with Cisco AnyConnect on macOS Catalina, you must use Cisco AnyConnect 4.8 or later. There is a known interoperability issue between Cisco AnyConnect 4.7 and macOS Catalina. To learn more, see the Cisco documentation.
